dct_title_s: Map showing residential districts created under the 1915 law : City of Minneapolis 1922
dct_alternative_sm: Map showing residential districts created under the 1915 law : City of Minneapolis 1922
dct_description_sm: Blue line print map of Minneapolis with added hand-marking and hand-coloring demarcating residential districts created under the 1915 zoning law. Shows: Districts petitioning for restriction; Districts restricted by Resolution of City Council; Districts recommended for Annulment; Districts Annulled.; Handwritten portion of title is prepended to title area of printed base map.; Notes and calculations written in pencil in right margin and on map surface.; In pencil on map recto and verso: "1061/805."; In pencil on map verso: "B-5/E-75."
